title.en: We have to get up early!

summary: The night before the train: everyone has something they have to do.

lines.speaker: Ammu
lines.en: The train is at ten tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Ammu
lines.en: Everyone has to get up early.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: What time do we have to get up?

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: সাতটায়! আমি সাতটায় উঠতে পারি না!
lines.tr: shattay! ami shattay uthte pari na!
lines.en: At seven! I can't get up at seven!

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.bn: আমাকে কাল সকালে কাজ করতে হবে। আমি পরশু আসব।
lines.tr: amake kal shokale kaj korte hobe. ami porshu ashbo.
lines.en: I have to work tomorrow morning. I'll come the day after.

lines.speaker: Ammu
lines.en: Rafi, you have to sleep now.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: কিন্তু আম্মু, আমাকে উপহার কিনতে হবে!
lines.tr: kintu ammu, amake upohar kinte hobe!
lines.en: But Mom, I have to buy a gift!

lines.speaker: Ammu
lines.bn: চিন্তা নেই, আমি গতকাল কিনলাম। এখন ঘুমাতে যাও!
lines.tr: chinta nei, ami gotokal kinlam. ekhon ghumate jao!
lines.en: Don't worry, I bought one yesterday. Now go to sleep!

questions.question: What does everyone have to do?
questions.why: উঠতে হবে = have to get up; তাড়াতাড়ি = early.

questions.question: At what time does everyone have to get up?

questionBn.en: At what time does everyone have to get up?

questions.why: The train is দশটায় (at ten), so they get up সাতটায় (at seven).

questions.question: Why isn't Nadia going tomorrow?
options: She has to buy a gift
questions.why: আমাকে কাজ করতে হবে = I have to work. পরশু = the day after tomorrow.

questions.question: Who has already bought the gift?
questions.why: আমি গতকাল কিনলাম = I bought it yesterday, says Ammu.
